---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---
This page analyzes the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide gross revenue. 
```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-rev
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide Box Office Revenue vs. Production Budget"
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"], alpha=0.7, color="skyblue", edgecolors="black")
plt.xlabel("Production Budget ($ Millions)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue ($ Millions)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.show()
